Sections (roman numerals printed; -sN- by printed order, numeral kept in section_signal): s1 I mcq q1-5; s2 II fill q6-20; s3 III true/false q21-30; s4 IV match q31 (one 5-row table, the number fused 'IV. 31.'); s5 V one-mark vsa q32-45; s6 VI two-mark sa q46-59; s7 VII three-mark sa q60-62; s8 VIII four-mark la q63-66; s9 IX 'Project Work (Four Marks Questions)' q67 typed sa (activity task, as evs-4-01 q61 / evs-3-02 q25).

MARKS (R-E5, printed section marks win): V '(one-mark questions)' 1, VI '(two marks questions)' 2, VII '(three marks questions)' 3, VIII '(four marks questions)' 4, IX '(Four Marks Questions)' 4 -> marks_source section_header; I-IV print no marks -> null + 'unassigned' + 'marks ambiguous in source — no marks printed' (31 q).

DIFFICULTY: every question prints its own tag. '(Medium)' -> average (R-E2), '(Hard)'/'(hard)' -> difficult (v2 §6 word map, as evs-4-05 q57), '(Hardest)' (q63, q65, q66) -> difficult (same word map; a form not seen in Classes 3/4); printed form kept in difficulty_as_printed. No flag is added for Medium/Hardest: R-E2's 'difficulty tag printed as Medium' is not a gate-2.20 vocabulary term and the coordinator's launch note asks for the printed form kept (READY D-item). q45 tag printed '[(Easy)' (stray '[' dropped from text).

KEYS — the key side is a machine translation of a Kannada key (R-E4): every key stored verbatim. 'printed key doubted' (carried as 'unclassified — printed key doubted: …', pending_category 'unclassified', because the ruled term is not gate-2.20 vocabulary) on transliterations (q9 'Mishrahari', q19 'Ayushkala', q31 row 4), wrong-looking words (q8 'A flower', q11 'Directory', q32, q44 'Neptune plant', q51 'green phosphorus', q61 'Mixer', q62 'Divincial', q66 'soil slope') and label-form true/false keys ('Ok'/'ok'/'Okay' -> true, 'Wrong'/'wrong' -> false: q21-24, q26-30). q25 '—False' is a plain key, not flagged. The extractor's reading is offered only in suggested ('reviewer: …'); no key is translated or corrected.

MONTH-NAME LABELS (R-E4b): q3 options print 'April 20' and 'December 150' (the render shows the same words — auto-translation damage of 'A. 20' / 'D. 150'); option letters A and D restored in the label only, texts '20' / '150' kept, flag 'option label restored from text-layer artefact' with the printed string (carried as 'unclassified — …'). No other month-name label in the lesson. Option labels otherwise print mixed case ('b.leg', 'b. Oxygen') -> ids A-D.
MCQ keys print text only (no letter): two-pass normalised match, every key matched exactly one option in pass 1 (source_corrections record the derived letter, addendum §4.2).

TRUE/FALSE keys restate the statement and append the label ('…—Wrong'); the whole printed key line is answer_as_printed. q28's key RE-WORDS the statement ('Humans are omnivores.—Okay') against the stem 'Human beings are carnivores.': label asserted (true) + 'printed key contradicts fact' (review-blocking). q27's stem prints its own parenthetical '(This is a national park)' (kept in text as printed; it gives the answer away).

MATCH q31: question side column headers 'a' / 'B'; column-B labels print 'A.', 'B.', 'S.', 'd.', 'c.' (no 'C' or 'E'); the key side reprints the table with matched rows ('c. Green plants', 'C. Vegetarian', 'a. Non-vegetarian', 'b. Mishrahari', 'D. Insectivorous plant') and the letter line 'Answers: 1 – E, 2 – C, 3 – A, 4 – B, 5 – D'. Pairs taken from the key's table rows verbatim (no label resolution needed: the rows and the letters agree when column-B's 'S.' is read as C and 'c.' as E). Two values differ from column B -> 'match key value not among column-B items'.

KEY FINDINGS (review-blocking): q28 and q33 ('Man' as a carnivore) and q42 (Thimmakka 'Shivamogga') -> 'printed key contradicts fact'; q52 (key describes growth, not the benefits of food) -> 'key text does not address question'; q67 project work -> 'no answer printed'.

Multi-line keys: q49 2 lines -> 2 steps; q60 and q61 a bold heading line on the key's number line + 3 lines -> 3 steps (heading not a step, addendum §5.2); q62 3, q64 4, q65 3, q66 4 lines -> one step per line ('o' bullet glyphs dropped). Wrapped paragraphs joined: q37, q39, q53, q63.

Stems: q18 prints a stray '5.' after its label (dropped from text, kept in text_as_printed); stray ' .' after q34-q36 and '[' before q45's tag dropped from text only. Source spellings kept: 'Drocera', 'Salamarada Thimmakka', 'herbivores, carnivores, carnivores' (q61), 'hybrids' (q67), 'Mishrahari' (q31 column B).

LO (R-E10): the lesson prints a numbered list of 10 learning outcomes for the whole lesson and maps none to a question -> the full list recorded on every question (learning_outcomes, lo_source 'lesson_table' = lesson-level provenance, not a per-question mapping); no 'no LO mapped' flag.

TOPIC (R-E7): EVS map v1 evs-5-01 has named sections (s00 Introduction untickable, s01-s10 tickable), so R-E3's t00 does not exist. Each question tagged by section TITLE to the tickable section(s) its content names ('content','high'); where no single title is clear (general characteristics of living things, annual/perennial plants, environment, Thimmakka, solar energy) ALL ten tickable sections ('content','low'); s00 never used. Mapping in the unit summary.

FIGURES: pdfimages lists no image on pdf 5-8 or 70-73; pdfplumber finds no curves (rects = page border/rules). No picture-based question; no stimuli; q67 asks the pupil to collect pictures (nothing printed).
